{{Quote|Or perhaps it is investigating the mysteries of the galaxy, seeking out injustice, and bringing it to light? Such are the ways of the Jedi Watchman in the time of Ulic Qel-Droma...and Exar Kun.|Former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kreia]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
'''Jedi Watchman''' was a specialized role of the [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinels]] who operated throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as guardians of specific [[Planet/Legends|planets]] or [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].

==Overview==
These [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] opted to stay in one place, operating alongside a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] or system government and ensuring diplomacy was maintained in all matters. These Jedi would also oversee the testing and reporting of any [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] born in their sector, turning the child over to the [[Acquisition Division]] if a positive result was returned. The Watchmen's role in the Order was canonized in Jedi writing with the publication of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'' and the inclusion of text written by [[Jedi recruiter]] [[Morrit Ch'gally/Legends|Morrit Ch'gally]].<ref name="TJP" />

The Watchmen's presence in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] ebbed and flowed with the passage of time. [[Arca Jeth]], an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] Jedi master with several Jedi apprentices under [[Gender/Legends|his]] guidance, was appointed Watchman to the [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] system and duly brought peace to the war-torn system before his demise on the planet [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]]. During the rule of the [[Sith Triumvirate]], the Watchmen had been extinct for decades, with [[Meetra Surik]], under the alias of the Jedi Exile, being the first to show interest in the role since the start of the [[First Jedi Purge]]. Returning with the rebuilding of the Order, the Watchmen took up their familiar posts throughout the galaxy. Studying special [[Force power/Legends|Force techniques]] to better equip themselves for their missions, Watchmen were skilled at fading into the background, allowing them to subtly manipulate political events in a benevolent fashion to sustain peace and prosperity. Serving as an extension of the [[Council of Reconciliation/Legends|Council of Reconciliation]] and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], the Watchmen were trusted to make their own decisions based on their familiarity with the local governments, without having to report back to the Councils before making every decision.<ref name="TJP" />

In the event that a Watchman should step down or join one of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councils]], another Knight was assigned as replacement, such as in the cases of Masters [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who were replaced by Knights [[Tarr Seirr]] and [[Kai Justiss]] respectively. Master Yoda, however, kept a close friendship with the people of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], a relationship that would save his life during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].

Prior to the [[Battle for Outbound Flight|Outbound Flight incident]], Master [[Jorus C'baoth]] served as the Jedi Watchman of the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan System]]. He mediated tensions between the [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa]] and [[House of Antilles|Antilles]] [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Houses]] over which noble family would succeed to the position of [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]].<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref> Master C'baoth resolved the [[Alderaan Ascendancy Contention]] crisis by arranging a [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] between the two families.<ref name="Pello Scrambas">{{DB|character|pelloscambras|Scrambas, Pello}}</ref> 

[[Belsed-Qan Idan]] served as the Jedi Watchman of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], but he was reassigned to the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]]<ref name="HNN Acks Moe">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_1.html|Senator Moe Killed in Blast}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="HNN 22 date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|jediwatch/13328_1.html|Jedi Smash Iridium Pirates; 3 Knights Killed}} is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:3:28," which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> to co-lead a Jedi [[Task force/Legends|taskforce]] sent to deal with the [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|Pirates of Iridium]].<ref name="HNN Iridium Pirates">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|jediwatch/13328_1.html|Jedi Smash Iridium Pirates; 3 Knights Killed}}</ref> Idan had not returned to Aargau by the time of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe's]] [[Death/Legends|death]], which angered some [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] government officials, such as [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]].<ref name="HNN Acks Moe" />

Later in 22 BBY, the Watchman of the planet [[Cadinth]], [[Bodis-Ker Vitan]], was killed in a pro-[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] uprising. After the Jedi's death, Cadinth's government withdrew its previous statements of support for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and declared it was "undecided" regarding its loyalty to the Republic.<ref name="HNN Cadinth">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|jediwatch/1359_2.html|Cadinth Loyalty Uncertain After Jedi Death}}</ref>

===Jedi recruiter===
{{Main|Jedi recruiter}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the computer game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', Jedi Watchman is one of the six prestige character classes which the main character can select after reaching level 15. Like its [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] counterpart, [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]], this class corresponds to the [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinel]] non-prestige class.
